properties: method: password | phone
trigger: User submits the sign-up form / requests phone OTP

properties: method: password | phone | google | line
trigger: Account created — password/phone via the *_signup method tag; SSO (Google/LINE) detected by a just-now createdAt in setUser so social signups are no longer counted only as Signed In

properties: method: password | phone | google | facebook | line
trigger: Fresh non-impersonation authentication succeeds (not fired on cookie-restore reloads or for backoffice_* impersonation — those set the is_impersonation super property instead)

properties: provider: line | facebook; mode: signin | signup
trigger: User clicks a social-login button and is redirected to the provider — LINE + Facebook (Google's GIS button is a cross-origin iframe whose click we cannot capture)

properties: step: welcome | connect-platform | connect-shop | …; step_number: int; total_steps: int
trigger: User advances a step in the onboarding modal

properties: step: current step id
trigger: User skips the onboarding modal

properties: platform: string?; shop_connected: bool
trigger: User finishes onboarding and enters the workspace (activation moment)

properties: platform: shopee | lazada | tiktok; app_type: default | ads | ams | erp?; source: onboarding | add_shop | shop_settings
trigger: User clicks connect and the platform auth URL opens

properties: platform: shopee | lazada | tiktok; app_type: default | erp | ads | ams; shop_id: string; source: oauth_callback
trigger: Fires deterministically on the OAuth result/callback page on a successful shop-data grant (ads/ams add-on scopes excluded) — replaces the old window-refocus new-shop diff so connects via shop settings and reauth are captured too
page: OAuth result tab (onboarding · add-shop · shop settings connect)

properties: kind: DecisionKind; platform: string
trigger: User initiates deploy on an action card (before gate dialogs)

properties: kind: DecisionKind; platform: string; domain: product | ads?
trigger: Deploy mutation succeeds on the backend

properties: kind: DecisionKind; platform: string; domain: product | ads?
trigger: Dismiss mutation succeeds

properties: kind: DecisionKind; platform: string
trigger: Seller expands the collapsible "why" rationale (Click to learn more) on an action detail panel

properties: platform: shopee; product_count: int; target_margin: number
trigger: User requests a set-margin preview for selected products

properties: platform: shopee; product_count: int; target_margin: number
trigger: Set-margin apply succeeds

properties: lever: discount_trim; scope: variant | item | all; variant_count: int; failed_count: int?
trigger: Commission-adjust apply succeeds from the products panel (board deploys land as Decision Deployed kind=commission_adjust)

properties: variant_count: int
trigger: Price-raise .zip (one .xlsx per COGS source) download succeeds from the Adjust panel (Shopee-only; stateless — nothing applied)

properties: cutoff_pct: number?; buffer_pct: number?; protect_mode: profit | margin | null; target_margin_pct: number?; generated_count: int
trigger: Seller rebuilds the upcoming commission change's recs (generate regenerate:true — rejects open recs + recreates) from the Adjust panel settings popover with tuning knobs (Shopee-only)

properties: platform: shopee; field_count: int; fields: string[]
trigger: Financial-breakdown apply succeeds with no blocking warnings

properties: platform: shopee | lazada; row_count: int
trigger: COGS spreadsheet apply succeeds

properties: platform: shopee | tiktok | lazada; row_count: int
trigger: Stock spreadsheet apply succeeds (canonical saved + queued for Shopee sync)

properties: platform: shopee | lazada | tiktok_shop | all_shops; processed_rows: int; updated_count: int; error_count: int
trigger: Canonical shop-batch XLSX upload returns a result (nickname/stock/COGS upsert by canonical_variant_id); platform=all_shops for the all-shops/all-platforms upload

properties: source: product_detail; current_count: int; historical_count: int
trigger: Product history modal saved — current-row edits via upsert-products + bounded/new windows via upsert-historical-cogs (name/nickname/sku/model_sku/COGS per window)

properties: plan: string; flow: change_plan?
trigger: User starts a Stripe checkout (new sub or plan change)

properties: plan: string?
trigger: User lands back from Stripe after successful payment (client proxy; webhook on dgbe is authoritative)

properties: utm_source: string?; utm_medium: string?; utm_campaign: string?; paid: bool; referrer: string
trigger: Sign-up page mounts — measures landing → signup-page → started conversion

properties: method: password | phone; reason: ApiErrorType; status: int?
trigger: Sign-up request throws (validation / conflict / network / server)

properties: method: password | phone | google; reason: ApiErrorType; status: int?
trigger: Sign-in request throws

properties: endpoint: string (path only); status: int; method: string
trigger: A backend call fails with a network error or 5xx (4xx + recovered-401 retries excluded)

properties: platform: shopee; shop_id: int; app_type: default | ads | ams; stage: FAILED; total_jobs: int; completed_jobs: int
trigger: Pipeline sync status reads FAILED (fires once per shop+app_type per session)

properties: platform: shopee | lazada | tiktok; source: product_row | financial_breakdown | bulk_upload; product_count: int; shop_id: int?
trigger: COGS saved for a product by any path (inline row/model/sku edit · financial-breakdown apply with manufacturingCogs · bulk upload) — the "set COGS for even one product" activation signal; fires on set only (not clear)

properties: step: connect-shop | connect-platform; platform: shopee | lazada | tiktok?
trigger: User opens the "Why do I need to connect?" explainer modal on an onboarding connect step
page: onboarding connect step (platform picker · per-platform connect)
